unclassified.source_text: The minimum requirement for the degree is 128 units.
unclassified.why: Overall degree unit total is a general programmatic fact rather than a filter-measure-bound pool constraint covered by any family.

unclassified.source_text: In addition to the 20 units of general education requirements above, the GE-D, GE-E, and GE-F general education requirements are satisfied by the Biology, Physics, and Mathematics pre-major requirements, respectively.
unclassified.why: This is an explanatory equivalence statement about how GE categories are satisfied, not a new independent constraint on course selection.
